description: This file provides internationalization (i18n) support for the Select2 plugin, specifically the Thai language translations for various UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when data cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to type more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown while loading additional data.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message shown when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
